titleEnglish: The Signs and Miracles of His Blessed Birth ﷺ

verses.ar: وَظَهَرَ عِنْدَ وَلَادَتِهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَوَارِقُ وَغَرَائِبُ غَيْبِيَّةْ ۞ إِرْهَاصًا لِنُبُوَّتِهِ وَإِعْلَامًا بِأَنَّهُ مُخْتَارُ اللّٰهِ تَعَالَى وَمُجْتَبَاهْ ۞ فَزِيدَتِ السَّمَاءُ حِفْظًا وَرُدَّ عَنْهَا الْمَرَدَةُ وَذَوُو النُّفُوسِ الشَّيْطَانِيَّةْ ۞ وَرَجَمَتْ نُجُومُ النَّيِّرَاتِ كُلَّ رَجِيمٍ فِي حَالِ مَرْقَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-ẓahara ʿinda wilādatihi ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama khawāriqu wa-gharā'ibu ghaybiyyah, irhāṣan li-nubuwwatihi wa-iʿlāman bi-annahu mukhtāru Llāhi taʿālā wa-mujtabāh, fa-zīdati s-samā'u ḥifẓan wa-rudda ʿanha l-maradatu wa-dhawū n-nufūsi sh-shayṭāniyyah, wa-rajamat nujūmu n-nayyirāti kulla rajīmin fī ḥāli marqāh.
verses.en: At his birth, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, extraordinary wonders and unseen marvels appeared as signs heralding his Prophethood and proclaiming that he was the one chosen and elected by Allah Most High. And the heavens were further guarded, and the rebellious ones and those of satanic souls were driven away from them, and the radiant stars pelted every accursed one as he attempted to ascend.

verses.ar: وَتَدَلَّتْ إِلَيْهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْأَنْجُمُ الزُّهْرِيَّةْ ۞ وَاسْتَنَارَتْ بِنُورِهَا وِهَادُ الْحَرَمِ وَرُبَاهْ ۞ وَخَرَجَ مَعَهُ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نُورٌ أَضَاءَتْ لَهُ قُصُورُ الشَّامِ الْقَيْصَرِيَّةْ ۞ فَرَآهَا مَنْ بِطَاحُ مَكَّةَ دَارُهُ وَمَغْنَاهْ ۞ وَانْصَدَعَ الْإِيوَانُ بِالْمَدَائِنِ الْكِسْرَوِيَّةْ ۞ الَّذِي رَفَعَ أَنُوشَرْوَانُ سَمْكَهُ وَسَوَّاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-tadallat ilayhi ṣalla Llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallama l-anjumu z-zuhriyyah, wa-s-tanārat bi-nūrihā wihādu l-ḥarami wa-rubāh, wa-kharaja maʿahu ṣalla Llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallama nūrun aḍā'at lahu quṣūru sh-Shāmi l-qayṣariyyah, fa-ra'āhā man biṭāḥu Makkata dāruhu wa-maghnāh, wa-n-ṣadaʿa l-īwānu bi-l-Madā'ini l-kisrawiyyah, alladhī rafaʿa Anūsharwānu samkahu wa-sawwāh.
verses.en: The radiant stars drew near to him, may Allah send prayers and peace upon him, and by their light the valleys and hills of the Sacred Sanctuary were illuminated. With him, may Allah send prayers and peace upon him, came forth a light by which the imperial palaces of Syria were illuminated, and they were seen by those whose homes and dwellings were in the plains of Makkah. And the imperial palace at al-Mada'in was split apart, whose lofty structure Anushirwan had raised and fashioned.

verses.ar: وَسَقَطَ أَرْبَعٌ وَعَشْرٌ مِنْ شُرُفَاتِهِ الْعُلْوِيَّةْ ۞ وَكُسِرَ سَرِيرُ الْمَلِكِ كِسْرَى لِهَوْلِ مَا أَصَابَهُ وَعَرَاهْ ۞ وَخَمَدَتِ النِّيرَانُ الْمَعْبُودَةُ بِالْمَمَالِكِ الْفَارِسِيَّةْ ۞ لِطُلُوعِ بَدْرِهِ الْمُنِيرِ وَإِشْرَاقِ مُحَيَّاهْ ۞ وَغَاضَتْ بُحَيْرَةُ سَاوَةَ وَكَانَتْ بَيْنَ هَمَذَانَ وَقُمَّ مِنَ الْبِلَادِ الْعَجَمِيَّةْ ۞ وَجَفَّتْ إِذْ كَفَّ وَاكِفُ مَوْجِهَا الثَّجَّاجِ يَنَابِيعُ هَاتِيكَ الْمِيَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-saqaṭa arbaʿun wa-ʿashrun min shurufātihi l-ʿulwiyyah, wa-kusira sarīru l-maliki Kisrā li hawli mā aṣābahu wa-ʿarāh, wa-khamadati n-nīrānu l-maʿbūdatu bi-l-mamāliki l-fārisiyyah, li-ṭulūʿi badrihi l-munīri wa-ishrāqi muḥayyāh, wa-ghāḍat buḥayratu Sāwata wa-kānat bayna Hamadhāna wa-Qumma mina l-bilādi l-ʿajamiyyah, wa-jaffat idh kaffa wākifu mawjiha th-thajjāji yanābīʿu hātīka l-miyāh.
verses.en: Fourteen of its lofty balconies fell, and the throne of Kisra was broken by the terror of what had befallen him. And the fires worshipped throughout the Persian realms were extinguished at the rising of his radiant full moon and the shining of his countenance. Lake Sawah, which lay between Hamadhan and Qumm in the Persian lands, receded and dried up when the abundant flow of its surging waters ceased, along with the springs that fed them.

verses.ar: وَفَاضَ وَادِي سَمَاوَةَ وَهِيَ مَفَازَةٌ فِي فَلَاةٍ وَبَرِّيَّةْ ۞ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِهَا مِنْ قَبْلُ مَاءٌ يَنْقَعُ لِلظَّمْآنِ اللّٰهَاهْ ۞ وَكَانَ مَوْلِدُهُ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالْمَوْضِعِ الْمَعْرُوفِ بِالْعِرَاصِ الْمَكِّيَّةْ ۞ وَالْبَلَدِ الْحَرَامِ الَّذِي لَا يُعْضَدُ شَجَرُهُ وَلَا يُخْتَلَى خَلَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-fāḍa wādī Samāwata wa-hiya mafāzatun fī falātin wa-barriyyah, lam yakun bihā min qablu mā'un yanqaʿu li-ẓ-ẓam'āni l-lahāh, wa-kāna mawliduhu ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama bi-l-mawḍiʿi l-maʿrūfi bi-l-ʿIrāṣi l-Makkiyyah, wa-l-baladi l-ḥarāmi lladhī lā yuʿḍadu shajaruhu wa-lā yukhtalā khalāh.
verses.en: The Valley of Samawah overflowed, though it was a waterless wilderness in a barren and desolate land where, before this, there had been no water to quench the thirst of the parched. And his birth, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, took place at the location known as al-Iras in Makkah, within the Sacred City, whose trees may not be cut down and whose wild herbage may not be gathered.

verses.ar: وَاخْتُلِفَ فِي عَامِ وَلَادَتِهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَفِي شَهْرِهَا وَفِي يَوْمِهَا عَلٰى أَقْوَالٍ لِلْعُلَمَاءِ مَرْوِيَّةْ ۞ وَالرَّاجِحُ أَنَّهَا قُبَيْلَ فَجْرِ يَوْمِ الِاثْنَيْنِ ثَانِيَ عَشَرَ شَهْرِ رَبِيعٍ الْأَوَّلِ مِنْ عَامِ الْفِيلِ الَّذِي صَدَّهُ اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَنِ الْحَرَمِ وَحَمَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-khtulifa fī ʿāmi wilādatihi ṣalla Llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallama wa-fī shahrihā wa-fī yawmihā ʿalā aqwālin li-l-ʿulamā'i marwiyyah, wa-r-rājiḥu annahā qubayla fajri yawmi l-ithnayni thāniya ʿashara shahri rabīʿin l-awwali min ʿāmi l-fīli lladhī ṣaddahu Llāhu taʿālā ʿani l-ḥarami wa-ḥamāh.
verses.en: The scholars have differed regarding the year of his birth, may Allah send prayers and peace upon him, as well as its month and its day, with various opinions having been transmitted. The strongest view is that it occurred shortly before dawn on Monday, the twelfth of Rabi al-Awwal, in the Year of the Elephant, which Allah Most High turned away from the Sacred Sanctuary and thereby protected it.

verses.ar:
عَطِّرِ اللّٰهُمَّ قَبْرَهُ الْكَرِيمَ بِعَرْفٍ شَذِيٍّ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَتَسْلِيمٍ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
ʿAṭṭiri Llāhumma qabrahu l-karīma bi-ʿarfin shadhiyyin min ṣalātin wa-taslīmin.
Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalayhi.
verses.en:
O Allah, perfume his noble grave with a fragrant scent of prayers and peace.
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon him.
